title: Knife-wielding man hit with stun gun dies
article: The RCMP's major crimes unit is investigating the death of a man who died after being shot with a police electric stun gun.
RCMP were called to a hotel in this Vancouver suburb late Saturday night after a man came in wielding a knife and a hammer.
When he resisted arrest an officer shot him with a Tazer, which sends out a high-voltage electrical charge.
The 51-year-old man's heart stopped shortly afterward. Paramedics were called and tried to revive him. The man was rushed to hospital, where he was pronounced dead, police said in a news release.
RCMP spokesman Const. Phil Reid said the force's serious-crimes unit is always called in to investigate a death in custody.
